leakage_probes.limitation: At most 96 fixed IDs per side per coordinator at output times. Native reclassification at the stage handoff is disclosed; this is not strict impermeability verification.

local_flow.definition: Time mean of native local velocities in shared 8^3 bins; HemoCell node average and DPD particle average differ. Block scatter is descriptive, not a precise confidence interval.

host_resources.scope: 0.1 s sampled descendant process tree RSS sum across different process groups, includes shared pages in each process; not PSS or GPU VRAM
